opening.text: I've been dealing with a hoarse voice for about three months now. It started gradually, and I feel like there's a lump in my throat. I've also dropped 10 pounds in that time and just feel more tired than usual. I do smoke cigarettes, and my father had lung cancer while my mother had thyroid disease.
